title: Roller skate
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- boot: bright red, upper part -->
  <path d='M30 20 L62 20 L66 30 L66 52 L30 52 Z' fill='#ff3b3b'/>
  <!-- boot toe: lighter red shade to give edge -->
  <path d='M30 20 L42 20 L42 52 L30 52 Z' fill='#ff7a7a'/>
  <!-- ankle collar: orange -->
  <rect x='29' y='16' width='38' height='8' rx='4' fill='#ff9a1f'/>
  <!-- laces: pale cream stripes -->
  <rect x='34' y='26' width='26' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffe9b0'/>
  <rect x='34' y='33' width='26' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffe9b0'/>
  <rect x='34' y='40' width='26' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffe9b0'/>
  <!-- sole plate: teal -->
  <rect x='26' y='52' width='46' height='8' rx='3' fill='#1fd6b4'/>
  <!-- heel block: darker teal -->
  <rect x='30' y='60' width='14' height='8' rx='2' fill='#12a58b'/>
  <!-- wheels: yellow with lighter hub -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='72' r='9' fill='#ffd21f'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='72' r='4' fill='#fff59a'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='72' r='9' fill='#ffd21f'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='72' r='4' fill='#fff59a'/>
  <!-- front truck: purple -->
  <rect x='54' y='60' width='16' height='5' rx='2' fill='#a35bff'/>
  <!-- back truck -->
  <rect x='26' y='60' width='16' height='5' rx='2' fill='#a35bff'/>
  <!-- brake stop: pink -->
  <circle cx='74' cy='64' r='4' fill='#ff6fd8'/>
</svg>
